jobs.title: Director Consulting, Business Transformation & AI
jobs.description:
Position Description

Artificial Intelligence is reshaping every industry, transforming how organizations operate, innovate, and create value. But organizations aren't looking for more technology. They're looking for trusted advisors who can help them modernize operations, transform how work gets done, and realize measurable business outcomes.

At CGI, we're building on decades of consulting excellence, proven AI capabilities, and global innovation to help clients navigate this transformation. We're looking for a business consulting leader who can help expand that capability while influencing how we continue to bring AI enabled business transformation to market.

As Canada's largest IT and business consulting services firm, and a global leader with more than 400 offices worldwide, CGI combines the entrepreneurial spirit of a local business with the strength, scale, and expertise of a global organization. We call our employees Partners for a reason: 90% are shareholders who take ownership of our success. Here, you'll have the autonomy to influence strategy, the resources to make an impact, and the opportunity to help shape the future of consulting.

Your Role: Lead Transformation. Shape Strategy. Enable Growth.

As a Director Consulting, Business Transformation & AI, you'll serve as a senior business transformation consultant and trusted advisor, helping organizations understand how AI can create practical, measurable business value and realize sustainable value from their AI investments.

Working alongside CGI's Directors of Consulting Services, you'll bring deep expertise in business transformation and AI to strengthen client relationships, shape strategic opportunities, and guide organizations through complex transformation initiatives. Rather than owning client accounts, you'll complement our account leaders by helping clients develop transformation strategies, modernize business processes, and accelerate responsible AI adoption.

You'll also help shape the continued evolution of CGI's Business Transformation & AI consulting capabilities across the Atlantic Business Unit. Building on CGI's established consulting practice, global AI expertise, and proven client success, you'll have the opportunity to influence our strategy, evolve consulting offerings, strengthen our market presence, and help define how we continue delivering AI enabled transformation for our clients.

You'll collaborate closely with CGI's technical AI specialists, architects, and delivery teams, serving as the bridge between client business objectives and successful implementation.

If you're passionate about business transformation, executive advisory services, emerging technologies, and helping organizations prepare for what's next, we'd love to hear from you.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Client Leadership & Strategic Advisory

Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, business leaders, technology leaders, and executives on business transformation, AI adoption, and digital modernization.
Lead executive workshops that help organizations define transformation priorities, AI strategies, investment roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.
Advise clients on operating model redesign, organizational change, Responsible AI, governance, and workforce transformation.
Build trusted relationships with key client stakeholders, decision makers, and influencers, strengthening CGI's position as a trusted transformation partner.

Opportunity Shaping & Business Development

Provide business transformation and AI expertise that strengthens client relationships and shapes strategic opportunities.
Support executive presentations, discovery workshops, proposals, business cases, and transformation roadmaps.
Collaborate across CGI consulting, engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, data, and account and delivery teams to recommend and shape integrated client solutions.
Bring innovative thinking, market insight, and consulting expertise to strategic pursuits and client engagements.

Practice Leadership & Thought Leadership

Help shape and evolve CGI's Business Transformation & AI consulting capabilities across the Atlantic Business Unit.
Contribute to consulting methodologies, reusable assets, market offerings, executive workshops, and leading practices.
Mentor consultants and help build AI fluency across CGI's consulting Partner community.
Represent CGI through conferences, executive forums, industry events, and thought leadership initiatives while staying current on emerging business and technology trends.

Solution Leadership

Translate client business challenges into practical transformation opportunities enabled by AI and digital technologies.
Connect clients with the right CGI capabilities, technical specialists, delivery teams, and alliance partner solutions.
Help ensure consulting engagements deliver measurable business outcomes and long term client value.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

12+ years of experience in management consulting, business transformation, digital transformation, technology consulting, or advisory services.
Demonstrated success advising organizations on complex business transformation initiatives and translating emerging technologies into measurable business outcomes.
Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Data & Analytics, Digital Transformation, and the evolving technology landscape.
Demonstrated executive presence with the ability to influence senior client stakeholders, facilitate strategic discussions, and build trusted relationships.
Experience supporting business development through executive advisory, opportunity shaping, proposals, workshops, and strategic consulting engagements.
Comfortable collaborating with technical AI specialists and delivery teams without needing to be the primary solution developer.
Exceptional communication, facilitation, presentation, and relationship building skills.
Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Familiarity with Responsible AI, AI governance, enterprise transformation, and organizational change management.

Asset Qualifications

MBA or graduate degree in Business, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Organizational Change, or a related discipline.
Certifications in AI, Cloud, Business Architecture, Digital Transformation, Change Management, or related disciplines.
Experience working with public sector, healthcare, credit unions, financial services, utilities, or other regulated industries.
Bilingualism (English/French) is considered an asset.
Willingness to travel within Canada and internationally as required (travel estimated at 25% and primarily within Atlantic Canda).

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $100,000–$190,000. This role is an existing vacancy.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
At OSL Retail Services, we believe people are the heart of everything we do, and it is an exciting time to be part of something special! Our momentum is growing, and is fueled by innovation, collaboration, and a shared entrepreneurial spirit that drives real results. Founded in 2012 in Mississauga, Ontario, OSL delivers customized sales solutions in retail, direct sales, and customer acquisition, all built on a foundation of integrity, respect, and passion. Our culture thrives on connection, purpose, and growth. If you’re looking for a place where your talents are valued, your ideas matter, and your career can grow, we’d love to meet you.

About the opportunity:

Director, Information Technology and Digital Transformation

OSL Retail Services is a technology-enabled sales and retail services organization supporting some of North America’s leading brands. As Director, Information Technology and Digital Transformation, you will lead the delivery and evolution of enterprise technology services that support corporate operations, field teams, client programs, analytics, and business transformation initiatives.

Reporting to the SVP, Data and Technology, you will lead a team of managers and technical leads, alongside external partners and managed service providers. You will be responsible for ensuring OSL’s technology ecosystem, including cloud platforms, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, service management, AI governance, and digital workplace services, remains secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned to business objectives.

This role is the critical bridge between the SVP’s strategic direction and day to day technology delivery, translating strategy into measurable outcomes, while maintaining a strong focus on governance, operational excellence and value realization.

Location: Mississauga

Role Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Direction

Contribute to and execute the multi-year technology strategy in partnership with the SVP, Data and Technology, translating strategic direction into delivery roadmaps, programs, and measurable outcomes.
Identify opportunities where technology, automation, analytics, and AI can improve productivity, compliance, and competitive differentiation, and bring forward business cases for prioritization.
Provide leadership and oversight for technology governance, architecture standards, and enterprise technology decision-making within the role's mandate.
Ensure technology investments are prioritized based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and strategic alignment.

Enterprise Architecture & Technology Governance

Establish and maintain technology standards, reference architectures, and governance processes across the enterprise.
Ensure technology solutions are scalable, supportable, secure, and aligned with long-term business requirements.
Oversee Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) governance, source code management, release management, and deployment controls.
Drive technology rationalization and reduction of technical debt through platform consolidation and modernization initiatives.
Maintain oversight of enterprise SaaS platforms and ensure effective integration across business systems.

IT Operations & Service Delivery

Oversee enterprise IT service delivery across applications, infrastructure, networks, and SaaS platforms.
Ensure systems are stable, secure, and performant to support retail, field, and corporate environments.
Establish and maintain governance for incident management, change management, and release processes.
Drive continuous improvement in service reliability, responsiveness, and user experience
Ensure technology services support a geographically distributed workforce across retail, field, and corporate environments while maintaining consistent service levels and user experience.

Digital Transformation, Automation & AI Enablement

Lead enterprise modernization initiatives including cloud adoption, platform consolidation, workflow automation, and digital workplace transformation.
Operationalize and mature OSL's established enterprise AI governance program, aligned to ISO 42001 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, covering employee AI use, AI capabilities within SaaS platforms, and internally developed solutions.
Partner with business leaders to identify automation opportunities that improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and enhance data quality.
Deliver scalable, integrated solutions that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making, in partnership with the Business Intelligence and Data Services teams.
Balance innovation with operational resilience, cybersecurity requirements, compliance obligations, and cost management.

Financial Stewardship & Vendor Management

Manage the operational technology budget and contribute to the annual technology planning and investment prioritization led by the Executive Leadership Team.
Establish business cases and ROI measures for major technology investments and transformation programs.
Identify opportunities to optimize cost‑to‑serve through consolidation, automation, and strategic sourcing.
Manage vendor relationships, contract renewals, and licensing across the technology portfolio.

Cross Functional Partnership & Enablement

Build strong partnerships with Operations, Client Services, Finance, HR, Sales, and Analytics teams.
Act as a trusted technology advisor to business leaders, translating needs into scalable, secure solutions.
Represent IT in cross‑functional planning forums, transformation initiatives, and program reviews.
Ensuring technology decisions reflect both business value and operational reality.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead, coach and develop a technology team, alongside external partners responsible for the delivery of enterprise technology services.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer service excellence.
Establish succession planning, skills development, and workforce planning strategies that support future organizational growth.
Ensure team objectives, performance measures, and priorities are aligned to corporate goals.

What You Bring to the Table

10+ years of progressive Information Technology experience, including leadership responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, or digital transformation initiatives.
5+ years in a senior leadership role managing cross-functional technology teams, including experience leading through managers or team leads.
Experience leading enterprise cloud transformation initiatives utilizing Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 platforms.
Experience operating within a regulated or compliance-driven environment, including responding to clients or external security and audit requirements.
Experience supporting ISO 27001 or comparable security and governance frameworks.
Experience managing enterprise service management platforms and ITIL-based processes.
Experience evaluating and governing emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence and automation platforms.
Experience managing technology budgets and contributing to enterprise-level financial planning.
Experience supporting geographically distributed workforces across retail, field, and corporate environments.
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or related field or equivalent experience.

Preferred Certifications

ITIL Foundation or higher
CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent security certification
Microsoft Azure certification
ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor (asset)
Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent) (asset)

Let's Talk Perks

The salary range for this role is $150K to $170K, your final compensation will reflect your years of experience and beyond the numbers, we’re proud to offer a holistic package that includes:

Generous time off: Start with 3 weeks of vacation.
Comprehensive benefits package: Includes medical, dental, vision and a health spending account.
Retirement support: Company-sponsored RRSP matching program to help build your financial future.
Award-winning culture: Proud to be one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies for 8 years running — now a Platinum Club member.
Invested in you: Structured employee development programs designed to help you thrive.

We’re committed to supporting your success every step of the way. What are the next steps?

Interview Steps:

Step 1: If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first conversation with the recruiter.
Step 2: The next step is an in-person interview with the SVP, Data and Technology.
Step 3: Final step is an in-person interview with the Chief Operating Officer.

If this sounds like you and you’re excited to be a member of our team, please apply now.

We thank all interested applicants; however, only qualified candidates will be contacted.

This position requires successful completion of a criminal background check.

Disclaimer: As part of our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools to assist with certain stages, including initial resume screening and skills-matching assessments. These tools are designed to help our hiring team identify candidates whose experience and qualifications align closely with the requirements of the role. Please note that all final hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team. The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this job. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. In compliance with Ontario’s Bill 190, we confirm that this posting represents a current existing vacancy within our organization.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Director of Finance
Location:
Hamilton, ON | On-site (1 day WFH)
Work Type:
Permanent | Full-Time
Salary:
$130,000 - $170,000 + bonus + RRSP
Reports to:
President
Are you a hands-on finance leader who thrives in a high-growth environment and enjoys building teams, improving processes, and driving business performance?
We're partnering with a growing facilities services organization to recruit a Director of Finance
. Reporting directly to the President, this role offers the opportunity to shape financial strategy, strengthen reporting and systems, develop the accounting team, and support continued growth through organic expansion and acquisitions.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to combine strategic leadership with hands-on financial oversight. You'll partner with senior leadership and operational teams to improve profitability, establish accountability, implement automation, and prepare the organization for future growth and acquisitions.

Key Responsibilities

Lead finance strategy and align departmental priorities with organizational objectives.
Oversee month-end and year-end close, financial statements, reconciliations, and management reporting.
Lead annual external review engagements and oversee lender reporting, tax compliance, and internal controls.
Partner with Sales and Operations to establish KPIs, monitor performance, and identify opportunities to improve profitability.
Coach and develop the Assistant Controller and junior accounting team.
Improve accounting systems, reporting processes, and automation to increase accuracy and efficiency.
Oversee multi-entity financial operations, intercompany transactions, and preparation for consolidated reporting.
Lead the finance workstream for future acquisitions, including integration, systems alignment, and process standardization.

What You'll Bring

CPA designation would be a nice asset to have
Significant progressive experience in accounting and finance leadership, ideally within a high-growth organization.
Construction or industrial services industry background would be an asset
Knowledge of service-based revenue models, including recurring contracts, inspections, and project work.
Experience managing multiple legal entities, intercompany transactions, and consolidation preparation.
Strong financial reporting, internal controls, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis expertise.
Experience partnering with operational leaders to drive business performance and accountability.
Proven ability to coach and develop accounting teams.
Experience implementing ERP systems, cloud accounting platforms, reporting tools, and automation.
Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

What We Offer

A senior leadership role reporting directly to the President.
The opportunity to influence business strategy and financial performance.
Ownership of finance transformation, automation, and process improvement initiatives.
Involvement in acquisitions, integration, and organizational growth.
The opportunity to develop a stronger, more scalable finance function.

If you're a commercially minded finance leader who enjoys building, improving, and scaling a business, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Director of Finance And Operations
jobs.description:
Our client is an exciting Technology startup located in Toronto and they are looking for a Director of Finance & Operations. They are looking for an entrepreneurial, systems-minded operator who combines financial discipline with a relentless focus on improving how the organization works.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning, financial reporting, and controls.
Oversight of bookkeeping, payroll, payables, receivables, tax, audit, insurance, and regulatory obligations.
Development of financial reports to the leadership team
Development of financial and operational foundations used to launch new ventures.
The design and continuous improvement of internal workflows and services.
The identification and implementation of useful automation and AI-enabled tools.
Identify opportunities for automation, define the desired outcome and right resources and define goals for an implmentation

Requirements

A CPA designation along with experience in a startup, venture studio, professionalservices organization, investment environment, or multi-entity business
Over 5+ years experience owning both financial and operational outcomes in a growing organization
Strong command of budgeting, forecasting, cash management, reporting, accounting operations, and financial controls.
Experience defining and overseeing work performed by employees, contractors, and professional-services firms.
An entrepreneurial mindset: you actively find opportunities, test better approaches, and carry improvements through to completion.
Strong judgment, discretion, follow-through, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguity.
A customer-centric view of internal operations and genuine respect for your colleagues’ time.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Director of Finance — LCL Group of Companies

Location:
Moncton or Charlo, New Brunswick

Join our team! LCL Group of Companies is hiring an experienced Director of Finance
to lead and take full ownership of the accounting and finance functions across our group of construction companies, including L.C.L. Excavation (2006) Inc, Pavage J.R. Lagacé Paving Inc, and MacArthur's Paving (2026) Inc
.

Reporting directly to the President, this senior leadership role is responsible for overseeing financial operations, ensuring accurate and timely reporting, strengthening internal controls, and leading the accounting team. The Director of Finance will work closely with Operations to support financial performance, sound business decisions, and continuous improvement.

This position offers the opportunity to play an increasingly important role in the group's overall direction and become a key member of the senior leadership team.

Key Responsibilities

Take full ownership and accountability for the accounting and finance functions across the group of companies
Lead month-end and year-end closing processes, including financial statements and consolidated reporting across all companies
Oversee accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, reconciliations, and general ledger management
Manage construction job costing, Work-in-Progress (WIP) reporting, and project financial performance analysis
Work with Operations to review project cost-to-complete forecasts, estimated margins, and cost variances
Lead cash-flow forecasting, working capital management, and financial planning
Develop and oversee annual budgets, financial forecasts, and management reporting
Collaborate with Operations to evaluate profitability, equipment costs, capital expenditures, and opportunities for improvement
Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and consistent financial processes across the group
Lead improvements to Acumatica ERP and related financial systems to increase efficiency and reporting capabilities
Manage relationships with external accountants, financial institutions, and other professional advisors
Build, lead, mentor, and develop a strong and accountable accounting team
Provide financial analysis, insights, and recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions
Work closely with the President and senior leadership to support the group's continued growth and long-term financial performance
Develop, streamline, and standardize financial processes to improve efficiency, consistency, and ease of use, establishing reliable controls that allow for oversight and periodic review rather than constant hands-on involvement

What We're Looking For

7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including experience in a senior accounting or financial management role
Proven ability to lead an accounting department, manage teams, and take ownership of financial operations
Strong understanding of financial reporting, accounting principles, internal controls, and multi-company accounting
Experience with construction accounting, job costing, WIP reporting, and project forecasting strongly preferred
CPA designation preferred
Strong budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow management, and financial analysis skills
Demonstrated ability to improve financial processes, systems, and departmental performance
Proficiency with ERP systems and Excel; Acumatica experience is an asset
Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work collaboratively with operational teams and communicate financial information clearly
Proactive, accountable, and comfortable making decisions and managing competing priorities
A humble, hardworking, and results-driven approach to leadership

Why Join LCL Group?

Competitive salary
Full-time leadership position
Health and dental insurance
Retirement plan
Opportunity to take ownership of the financial operations of a growing group of construction companies
Direct involvement with the President and the opportunity to become a key member of the senior leadership team
Opportunity to build and develop a strong accounting team and improve financial systems and processes
A respected family-owned construction group with established operations throughout New Brunswick
